patterns.message: src/ is framework-free so the game stays portable. Put Next.js code in app/ and have it call plain functions exported from src/.

sim/, gen/ and game/ run headless and deterministically, so they cannot depend on presentation, input or audio. Push a GameEvent or expose state for render/ and audio/ to read; inputs arrive as InputFrame.

A brain is an input device (docs/DESIGN.md → AI players): it runs on one machine and its InputFrames are all the match ever sees of it, so sim/, gen/ and game/ never call into src/brain. Read what a bot needs from the match in src/brain/view.ts instead.

sim/, gen/ and game/ stay pure so runs replay deterministically. Report from outside the sim instead, for example in src/game-client.ts; to surface something only the sim knows, expose a read-only diagnostic the way planMisses and lastGenInfo do.

src/ must run under any host, so the game can't depend on Sentry. Call reportError, reportEvent, reportLog, addBreadcrumb, setTag or setContext from src/telemetry.ts (docs/TELEMETRY.md); the SDK is imported only by the host (instrumentation*.ts, app/sentry-*.ts).
